quote: today I shall meet people who are meddling, ungrateful, aggressive, treacherous, malicious, unsocial. All this has afflicted them through their ignorance of true good and evil.
the nature of the offender himself is akin to my own - not a kinship of blood or seed, but a sharing in the same mind, the same fragment of divinity.
whatever it is, this being of mine is made up of flesh, breath, and directing mind.
the flesh you should disdain - blood, bones, a mere fabric of nerves, veins, and arteries. Consider too what breath is - wind - and not even a constant
don't then let this directing mind of yours be enslaved any longer - no more jerking to the strings of selfish impulse, no more disquiet at your present or suspicion of your future fate.
it is high time now for you to understand the universe of which you are a part, and the governor of that universe of whom you constitute an emanation
there is a limit circumscribed to your time - if you do not use it to clear away your clouds, it will be gone, and you will be gone, and the opportunity will not return.
perform each action as if it were the last of your life: freed, that is, from all lack of aim, from all passion-led deviation from the ordinance of reason
see how few things a man needs to master for the settled flow of a god-fearing life.
self-harm, my soul, you are doing self-harm: and you will have no more opportunity for self-respect.
life for each of us is a mere moment, and this life of yours is nearly over, while you still show yourself no honour, but let your own welfare depend on other people's souls.
